samples.title: Cloud Services Agreement
characteristics: Complex SLA structure with service credits
Extensive compliance obligations (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR)
samples.notes: Comprehensive enterprise agreement between cloud provider and multinational banking institution. Features detailed technical specifications, disaster recovery terms, and regulatory compliance requirements.

samples.title: Master Services Agreement for Security Assessment Services
characteristics: Detailed rules of engagement and prohibited activities
Complex fee structure with multiple service types
samples.notes: Master services agreement for pharmaceutical company's security assessment program. Includes quarterly external testing, annual internal assessments, and social engineering campaigns with strict compliance requirements.

samples.title: Enterprise Services Agreement
characteristics: Multi-country payroll and HRIS services (6 countries)
Tax compliance guarantee with penalty reimbursement
Comprehensive benefits administration and time tracking
samples.notes: Enterprise services agreement for SaaS company with 8,500 employees across US, Canada, UK, Germany, India, and Australia. Comprehensive payroll processing, HRIS, benefits administration, and compliance services with multi-jurisdictional requirements.
